validated_surface: CEGAL official project page confirms TTL as sector platform; TTL /librerias exposes public associated-bookshop listing with profile pages; CEGAL Mapa de Librerías 2024|2025 reports 776 TTL platform bookstores and 2,754 independent bookstores in Spain; visible TTL pagination supports 776 via 32 pages with one row on the final page.
extraction_plan: Run included Spain TTL harvester in networked runtime: crawl /librerias pages for profile URLs, then crawl /libreria/<slug>_<id> profiles for address/contact fields. Produce profile URL ledger, normalized profile CSV, raw HTML, row-count QA, and hash manifest. Keep title inventory/availability observations separate from store entities.
minimum_fields_to_map: country; source_platform; source_owner; source_record_id; store_name; street_address; postal_code; city; province; phone; email; website; hours; source_profile_url; source_listing_page; platform_membership
typing_rules: Default platform_membership=ttl_associated_bookshop. Treat source as network-grade, not government open data. Do not use CEGAL 2,754 Spain-wide independent-bookstore census as TTL row count. Flag hybrid/store-type only from source name or profile content, not by assumption.
caveats: No public bulk CSV/JSON export found in this probe. The 776 count is official-report plus static-pagination supported, but full raw crawl and hash ledger remain pending. Dynamic location and inventory widgets may expose additional signals but should not be mixed into the bookstore-entity table.
next_probe: Run full polite paginated/profile crawl; verify unique profile URL count against 776; preserve raw HTML and profile-level hashes. If deferred, proceed to Poland OBK with Spain marked full_crawl_ready.

validated_surface: OBK official surfaces verify registry-grade national bookstore base. Institute of Books describes OBK as free public database of Polish stationary bookstores with address, activity profile, website, and more, built from bookseller submissions. OBK statistics archive reports 1,592 locations and 921 independent at end-March 2026; homepage live counter observed 1,584 księgarnie and 83 klubokawiarnie. Search/listing pages expose filters, static rows, pagination, and row fields.
extraction_plan: Run included OBK harvester in networked runtime: discover unfiltered listing route/API if present; crawl static /search pages and paginated variants; preserve raw HTML; parse row blocks for names, phones, hours, obfuscated email, websites, address/postal/city/voivodeship, map links, awards/certificates; reconcile unique rows against live counter and dated statistics.
minimum_fields_to_map: country; source_name; source_class; source_record_id_if_found; store_name; chain_or_network_name; phone; hours; email_obfuscated; website; street_address; postal_code; city; voivodeship; map_url; awards_certificates; bookstore_type; assortment_profile; source_url
typing_rules: Treat OBK as registry-grade. Preserve source chain/network labels. Keep independent/chain from source where exposed; otherwise infer only after known-chain audit. Keep used/antiquarian as overlay when type/assortment/name indicates antykwariat or used-book profile. Keep club-café as separate flag, not a bookstore replacement.
caveats: No public bulk CSV/JSON confirmed in this probe. Count signals conflict by context: dated statistics 1,592/921, homepage live counter 1,584 bookstores and 83 club-cafes, filtered search counts 249 and 425. Do not collapse until full crawl/API inspection.
next_probe: Run full polite OBK crawl in networked runtime; identify canonical unfiltered listing; compute unique row count and split filtered overlays; preserve raw HTML and hash manifest.

validated_surface: SA Booksellers /bookshops page exposes Current members table with header Bookstore, EmailAddress, FirstName, SAAddressLine1-4, SACity, SARegion, SAPostalCode, PhoneNumber. Parsed text line span 12-260 gives 249 raw row-like candidate lines, but the member table includes non-bookshop and noise rows.
extraction_plan: Fetch and archive /bookshops/ HTML; parse Current members block; preserve raw rendered line and HTML block; use email as strong delimiter where present; extract terminal phone candidate; classify entity_role_primary before promotion; exclude accounting/noise artifacts; split head-office/branch cases; preserve publishers/distributors/platforms in member-grade side table.
minimum_fields_to_map: country_or_territory; entity_name; raw_email; contact_person; raw_address; city; region; postal_code; raw_phone; entity_role_primary; role_flags; qa_status; source_url; source_line_or_order
typing_rules: Promote only true bookshop/bookseller/campus bookstore candidates after QA. Mark stationers and school/office suppliers as stationery_hybrid; publishers/presses/PASA/councils as publisher_or_institutional_member; distributors/logistics/services as non_store_book_trade; Takealot/Snapplify as online/platform; Head Office as branch_expansion_needed; Admin/Bank/Credit/Digital Payment/Transaction rows as exclude_noise.
caveats: Not a clean national bookstore registry. It is a public SABA member table for the book trade and includes storefront bookstores, stationery hybrids, publishers, distributors, professional services, chain head offices, online platforms, and apparent accounting/noise artifacts. Raw candidate line count should not be cited as bookstore count.
next_probe: Run harvester in networked runtime to capture raw HTML and parsed candidates; produce role-filtered staging table; then proceed to United States ABA/IndieBound endpoint probe.

ABA static result pages expose query-specific counts and row fields. IndieBound finder supports ZIP/city/address plus optional public ownership identity filters and uses geocoding for closest-store lookup.
extraction_plan: Run included ABA harvester in networked runtime: query BookWeb member-directory result pages by state/city and supplemental name-token routes; preserve raw HTML; parse linked name, external site, address, phone, description; dedupe by normalized name/address/website/phone; classify entity_role_primary before promotion. Use IndieBound only as locator/identity/geocoding overlay.
minimum_fields_to_map: country; source_name; source_query_url; source_query_result_count; entity_name; website; street_address; city; state_or_region; postal_code; phone; description_raw; entity_role_primary; role_flags; source_url; identity_flags_public_opt_in
typing_rules: Treat ABA directory as member/network authority, not a government registry. Distinguish physical bookstore_location, airport_branch, chain_branch, online_only_bookstore, mobile_pop_up_bookstore, planned bookstore, specialty comics/non-general bookstore, and review_needed. Directory rows mix physical, online-only, mobile/pop-up, airport branches, chain/concession rows, and malformed website values.
next_probe: Run networked query-matrix harvest and dedupe/role QA; then proceed to Canada CIBA / IndieBookstores.ca probe.

Render/probe CIBA Wild Apricot member directory for member rows. Crawl IndieBookstores.ca /bookstores/ with Load More/filter endpoint discovery; follow /locations/<slug>/ profiles for full address, phone, website, events_url, amenities, and nearby-store graph. Dedupe and classify before promotion.

extraction_plan: Run included Australia harvester in a networked runtime. Probe WordPress sitemaps and REST routes; crawl /store/<slug>/ profile pages; preserve raw HTML and parse profile fields. Stage every row, then classify physical bookstore_location vs online_only_bookstore vs used_antiquarian/specialist/chain/review_needed before promotion.
minimum_fields_to_map: country; source_name; entity_name; description_raw; street_address_full; locality; state_or_territory; postal_code; online_only_flag; email; phone; website; stockist_flags; gift_card_flags; voucher_flags; source_url; entity_role_primary; role_flags
typing_rules: Default physical profiles with address to bookstore_location. Mark explicit Online only as online_only_bookstore. Mark secondhand/antiquarian/used from description or category flags. next_probe: Run networked sitemap/REST/profile crawl and compare discovered profile count against finder/category filters; then proceed to New Zealand BookHub.
